# Using Skill Distill in Antigravity

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to Antigravity.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.agents/skills/skill-distill/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/skill-distill/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness antigravity --skill skill-distill
node packages/cli install --harness antigravity --skill skill-distill --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. Antigravity loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also name it in the request, for example: "Use the skill-distill skill to ...".

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.agents/skills/skill-distill` for a project install, or `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/skill-distill` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Ask the agent which skills it has loaded and check that `skill-distill` is listed.

## Notes

- Older versions use .agent/skills. Antigravity 2.0 documents ~/.gemini/config/skills for user scope; the IDE and codelab use ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills.
- Skill Distill needs Python 3.10+, git, bash, and tmux, plus the student harness CLI on PATH; run scripts/setup/doctor.py first. On Windows, run it inside WSL.
- Documentation: [Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/docs/skills) (path source: official).
